chants.vernacular_text: Look upon me and have mercy on me, O Lord; for I am abandoned and destitute; consider my abjection and my labour, and forgive me all my sins, my dear God. ℣. Unto you, O Lord, have I lifted up my soul; O my God, I trust in you; let me not be put to shame.
Cast your cares upon the Lord, and he shall sustain you. ℣. When I cried out to the Lord, he heeded my call against my assailants.
Be unto me a protecting God, and a house of refuge, to save me. ℣. My God, in you do I trust; O Lord, let me never be put to shame.
God is a just judge, strong and patient. Could he remain in anger continually?
Let those who know your name trust in you, O Lord; for you do not abandon those who seek you. Sing psalms to the Lord who dwells in Zion; for he does not forget the cry of the poor.
I have called out because you hear me, O God; incline your ear and hear my words.
Amen I say to you, whatever you ask in your prayers, believe that you shall receive it, and it shall be granted unto you.
